style: Crisp hand-drawn anime cel shading, confident dark outlines, bright local colours, restrained rim light. Preserve the reference token's exact species, colour, horn, markings and functional anatomy. No extra wings, limbs, accessories, weapons, text, borders or watermark. Full body, generous margin, readable silhouette. Flat chroma green #00FF00 background; avoid green light spill.

poses.idle: Neutral fighting stance, face right, full body, square composition.
poses.attack: Powerful species-appropriate attack pose, face right, full body, square composition.
poses.dodge: Evade sideways, preserve anatomy, full body, square composition.
poses.dash: Fast forward movement using the reviewed locomotion, face right, square composition.
poses.guard: Braced defensive posture, face right, square composition.
poses.hurt: Recoiling from a hit, face right, square composition.
poses.down: Defeated and resting on the ground, unharmed, square composition.
poses.victory: Triumphant pose, full body, square composition.
poses.cutin: Dramatic close-up for an anime cut-in, face right, 16:9 composition. Flat dark violet background instead of green.

review: Species defaults are suggestions. Curator must review the actual anatomy, locomotion, every sprite and the final manifest. Traits and art follow the token on transfer.

generation.sharedSheets: Generated once per species/kit and once per element; no per-battle generation.

projectile.prompt: Paint a species-specific {name}: {description} Palette {palette}. The projectile flies LEFT with its trail toward the RIGHT. Exactly four loop frames in a 2 by 2 grid, no gaps or grid lines. One effect per equal square panel at a consistent scale. Crisp anime cel shading, bright readable core and restrained glow, no creature or text. Uniform PURE BLACK #000000 background edge to edge; do not use green chroma key. No ground, frame, border or ambient haze.

strike.prompt: Paint a species-specific {name}: {description} Palette {palette}. An opaque physical whip/slash object with a dark outline, extending horizontally from the LEFT origin to the RIGHT tip. Use a thick brush: minimum main stroke width 48 pixels in a 1024-pixel-wide panel. Exactly TWO stacked equal panels in a 1 by 2 grid, no gaps or grid lines: relaxed extension, then taut contact with a restrained glow. Uniform PURE BLACK #000000 background, no creature, text, floor, border or haze. Preserve solid opaque local colour; this is not an additive glow.

impact.prompt: Paint an anime impact burst in the {element} element, palette {palette}. Exactly four equal panels in a 2 by 2 grid with no gaps or grid lines: tiny flash, expanding jagged spark, maximum burst with element particles, fading ring. One consistent centred burst per panel, crisp cel-shaded shapes. Uniform PURE BLACK #000000 background, no creature, text, ground, frame or ambient haze.
